because: The run drained its frontier without hitting the cap, and the old derivation read that as COMPLETE. It is not. The selection took 500 URLs from a seed pool of 1497 (33.4%), on a property whose sitemap carries ~240,328 URLs; and 106 of the 500 requested were DISALLOWED by robots.txt and never fetched, so only 394 pages were actually read. "The queue emptied" is not "the site is covered".
